profile.headline: C# .NET | Software Engineer 2 | Cloud Theory
profile.summary:
Principal Force leverages a talented software engineer with over four years of experience in programming, data analysis, and automation. The team benefits from expertise in Python, SQL, and Microsoft Excel to develop and optimize robust solutions for complex technical challenges. Recent contributions include enhancing system performance and streamlining workflows to improve organizational efficiency.  

With a strong foundation in software development and a commitment to delivering quality-driven results, efforts focus on bridging technical gaps and empowering collaborative innovation. A dedication to continuous learning ensures alignment with evolving industry trends and the delivery of impactful, scalable solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Participated in full-cycle software development projects, focusing on designing, building, and implementing web and process applications using technologies such as C# Microservices, JavaScript, and DevOps Pipelines in a Scrum environment.

Maintained a Loan Management System (LMS) using C#, Bash/Shell Scripts, and MSSQL Databases, ensuring system reliability and performance.

Collaborated with Argyle to develop an identity and work verification solution, expediting loan verifications and enhancing the customer funding process, which improved efficiency for loan representatives.

Troubleshot and resolved technical issues, resulting in improved production processes and increased client satisfaction within the Client Success department.

Contributed to team projects with a focus on problem-solving and innovation, leading to significant process improvements and streamlined operations.

positions.title: Customer Service Associate
positions.description:
● Maintained accurate and current customer account data with manual forms processing and digital information updates.
● Achieved and consistently exceeded revenue quota through product and service promotion during routine calls.
● Conferred with customers about concerns with products or services to resolve problems and drive sales.

positions.title: Ride Operator
positions.description:
● Resolved guest issues by identifying source of complaint and formulating corrective action with supervisor.
● Performed troubleshooting and routine maintenance to keep equipment in optimal working condition.
● Operated rides and attractions according to written guidelines to reduce injuries.
